integrity: Every asserted infinite statement has an explicit analytic proof; numerical tests are supplemental and not exhaustive. The 2019 date identifies a verified public real-axis precursor, while the complex-disk numerical observation was published in 2024.
limitations: Sharp only among centered Euclidean disks; no classification of the full basin or of all dynamics. General literature could contain an equivalent complex-disk theorem. Independent mathematical audit has not been performed.
title: Sharp complex convergence disk and exact radial envelopes for the Newton–sine map
